gloss: the real thing; actual performance; production

definitions.gloss: the real thing; actual performance; live take
definitions.explanation: The actual event, performance, or recording as opposed to a rehearsal, practice, or test run.

examples.japanese: ⟦いよいよ→いよいよ：06353_iyoiyo⟧{本番|ほんばん}だ。
⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上手|うま}くいった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{本番|ほんばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It went well in practice, but I messed up during the real performance.

examples.japanese: {本番|ほんばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Athletes who perform well under pressure produce good results at major tournaments.

notes:
{本番|ほんばん} refers to the actual event as opposed to a rehearsal, test, or practice (⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧, ⟦リハーサル→リハーサル：07559_rihaasaru⟧). It implies that the outcome now counts for real.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {本番|ほんばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: performs well when it counts
- {本番|ほんばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: chokes under pressure
- {本番|ほんばん}{前|まえ}: before the real event
- {本番|ほんばん}⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧: the day of the actual event

USAGE:
- Used in performing arts (theater, music), sports, filming, exams, and any situation with a decisive moment.
- ⟦リハーサル→リハーサル：07559_rihaasaru⟧ (rehearsal) and ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧ (practice) are the typical contrasts.
